The '''Diplomatic Summit at Sullust''' took place during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Two weeks after the [[Rescue of Sullustan Tech Staff|rescue]] of a Sullustan tech staff by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], leaders of the [[Sullustan Resistance|Sullustan resistance movement]] agreed to open [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] talks on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] to discuss entrance into the Alliance. However, the summit was attacked by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'' Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']], as part of [[Operation Strike Fear]]. Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Hamo Blastwell]] and [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], flying [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]], held off the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] until the meeting was concluded and all ships fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="XW-TOSG" />
